it makes no difference phrase

also it doesn’t matter, it amounts to the same thing, it comes to the same thing, it’s all the same to me, I’m content with it, I’ll put up with it, I accept that, what’s the difference anyhow!

classical

Traupman 96
Traupman 107: it’s all the same to me, meā nihil interest
Traupman 212: Meā nihil interest, it makes no difference to me

Nīl interest.

Other words

  • Nīl rēfert.

    also used · classical · Plaut. Pers. 537: meā quidem istuc nīl rēfert; Traupman 96

    To me, to you: nīl meā (tuā) interest or rēfert (Traupman 96).

  • aequī (bonīque) faciō — I’m content with it, it’s all the same to me

    phrase: genitive of value with faciō, the thing accepted in the accusative · also used · classical · Ter. Heaut. 4.5.40: istuc aequī bonīque faciō (Lewis & Short s.v. aequus); Plaut. Mil. 3.1.189: aequī istuc faciam, it will be all the same to me (Lewis & Short); Cic. Att. 7.7: tranquillissimus animus meus tōtum istuc aequī bonī facit (Lewis & Short); Traupman 98 (for “I think that’s fair”)

    Literally “I reckon it as fair (and good)”: said of putting up with what one cannot change. Lewis & Short: “to put up with, be content with, submit to”.

Examples

  • quod vērum an falsum sit, quoniam meā nihil interest, utrum mālim nesciō

    whether it is true or false, since it makes no difference to me, I don’t know which I would preferCic. Att. 11.25.2

  • Meā quidem istuc nīl rēfert: tuā ego hoc faciō grātiā.

    It makes no difference to me: I’m doing this for your sake.Plaut. Pers. 537

  • nec interest: parī hūmānitāte accipiuntur

    it makes no difference: they are received with the same kindnessTac. Germ. 21.3

  • Tantundem est.

    It amounts to the same thing.Traupman 92

  • Nīl (multum) meā interest utrum … an …

    It makes no (a lot of) difference to me whether … or …Traupman 303

  • Quid utique interest!

    What’s the difference anyhow!Traupman 303

  • Meā nihil interest.

    It’s all the same to me.Traupman 373

See also never mind, difference, that’s fair.
